title: CALIPER: Comparative Analysis of LLM Inference Perturbation, Evaluation, and Ranking
description: First public research release of CALIPER, a reproducible factorial LLM evaluation framework for variance-aware analysis, statistical design guidance, and ranking stability. Accompanying Paper 1 (Empirical Software Engineering manuscript in preparation). Authors: César Andrés (corresponding); David Martín-Moncunill; José Manuel Baños. Archival DOI: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21780089. Primary entry points: README.md, docs/getting-started.md, docs/author_identity.md. Experiment outputs are not bundled; regenerate from configs under configs/.
